title: 6.2 Transportation
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Use familiar and new transport words in I go by... sentences.
grammar_function: I go by + bus/train/car/bike/taxi; I walk.
prerequisite: 2.2 Streets and Transportation introduced bus, car, bike; 4.6 Everyday Verbs introduced go; 6.1 station.
speaking_outcome: Say five transport-mode sentences and I walk.

cards.pedagogy_note: Introduces by transport chunk using review noun.
Purposeful Unit 1/4 review; does not introduce on foot.
Reviews plural simple present; invalid form is text only.
In is known location distractor; completed audio only after choice.
Third-person form previously established in Unit 4 core and 5.5 agreement.
